items.topic: Update agent-docs before keeping/redoing blueprint rewrites
items.claim: Blueprint rewrites (bp04, bp07-bp10, bp12) were made against uncorrected agent-docs
items.fact: Operator: 'No stop them we udpate all the docs first! but stop!' Stop all subagents and fix the agent-docs first (from judo-doc-problems.md, tasks 3.3-3.5). The 37 rewritten blueprints and 29 new fragments are uncommitted and unchecked (no format/fragment check). Keep, re-check or redo them only after the docs are corrected.

items.topic: Sweep findings must be mined from session JSONLs via subagents
items.claim: Agent proposed only updating docs from judo-doc-problems.md
items.fact: Operator: 'Not jsut that a big sweep found A LOT of issues and they have put them into md files, find session jsonls and subagent(proxy) mines it!' The sweep produced far more findings than the curated judo-doc-problems.md (24 items, Part B 71 topics). Mine the session JSONLs with proxy-model subagents.

Sweep outputs live under judo-blueprint/target/: judo-ng-read/findings.md (12.6k lines), findings_rows.json (2864 rows: doc 1405, bug 1210, dox 249; areas runtime 1397, models 550, template 483, eclipse 181), judo-ng-read/out/*.json (per-batch findings + .validate.json), agent-docs-review/{backend,deployment,e2e-testing,frontend,integration-testing,model}.json + review.md, gap-mining/all_gaps.json (420 gaps), clusters.json (409). Curated results in openspec/changes/restructure-blueprints-for-kb/{judo-doc-problems.md,knowledge-gaps-report.md,judo-knowledge-reference.md,catalog-update-report.md,review-decisions.boti.md}. The sweep ran 882 subagents in one main session (reader-prompt.md/validator-prompt.md in target/judo-ng-read).

items.topic: Grep on pi session dirs needs ./ prefix
items.fact: Pi session dirs are named '--Users-bmiller-...--' so grep/ls treat them as options; use './*/*.jsonl' (cd ~/.pi/agent/sessions) or '--'. Sessions mentioning sweep artifacts: 12 JSONLs (judo-blueprint 2026-11-03/06 ~25-37MB, pi-agent-dashboard sessions).

openspec/changes/restructure-blueprints-for-kb/oneoff/mining/extract-sessions.py [--out target/mining/sessions] [--chunk-kb N] dedups forked-session messages and writes markdown chunks (users, assistant text, tool calls with short args, truncated results). 160KB chunks gave 29 chunks / 6208 unique messages; chunk-kb 60 was used for the rerun.

items.topic: context-mode replaces bash output >4096 B with ctx_search stub
items.fact: context-mode (pi/index.js) replaces tool output above CTX_REPLACE_TRIGGER_BYTES (default 4096) with a 'ctx_search(...) searches the whole output' stub; read with offset/limit is exempt (RANGE_READ_TOOLS Read/view with offset/limit/view_range). Plain read without range gets truncated. Hence miner prompts require offset+limit reads.

Subagent models are chosen with list_models; proxy refs look like proxy/cc/claude-sonnet-5-5, proxy/cc/claude-opus-5, proxy/cc/claude-opus-4-8. Agent tool: subagent_type 'sweep-miner', run_in_background true, timeout_s; max 12 running in parallel, rest queue; poll with AgentStatus (wait any/all), AgentCancel, AgentMessages.

items.topic: Miner subagents must be verified: partial reading
items.claim: Miners reported done after ~70 s, ~100k tokens on 2000+ line chunks
items.fact: Too fast to have read all lines. Chunk 010 miner admitted not reading the last ~200 lines. 300-line reads over 160KB chunks overflowed; fix was re-extracting with smaller chunks (60KB) and requiring windows of 200 lines recorded in a 'windows' field so coverage can be checked. Old results moved to out-v1.

items.topic: Review site must use dashboard Keycloak SSO
items.fact: From chunk 010 miner report: review site uses the dashboard's Keycloak SSO (silent PKCE, same realm and client), no separate login; reviewer AI sessions record decisions via review-decide.mjs set in the same turn; conflict settled by accepting one vote, no undo; page refresh rebuilds only changed components (cards/topic headers have update slots).

items.topic: Reload skills in all live sessions
items.fact: List sessions with mcp__pi_dashboard__list_sessions and send '/reload' to each using send_prompt, skipping the current session.
